data.name: I Don't Trust You  - a talk by Trekk
data.description: Live talk and presentation at the Meeting Center in the Decentraland Conference Center.  Be sure to use realm artemis-blue   https://play.decentraland.org/?position=23%2C116&realm=artemis-blue   The presentation focuses on the necessity of personal/business brand development because the digital landscape in the coming decade will be flooded with a new wave of people, ideas, projects, and businesses all competing for attention and dollars. Although counter to the nature of the crypto community, I highlight the importance of building a brand based on empathy, trust, and transparency to generate high social equity aiding the brand stand out.   Trekk is the face behind the shades. He uses the art of storytelling to provide beginner to advance education, real-world applications, and business solutions based on blockchain technology. As someone who lives in the gig economy and being involved in cryptos since 2013, Trekk delivers content in context to individuals and small business, by way of writing articles, public speaking, hosting a podcast, and private consultations.     There will be hackathon idea pitches after the presentation.

data.name: Keynote Speech by Ben Goertzel for the Planetwide SOS Hackathon
data.description:
Keynote Speech: Health, Longevity and Democracy via Decentralized AI.

SingularityNET is a decentralized, blockchain based network of AI agents — which lets AIs offer their services to customers via an API marketplace, and also lets AIs cooperate with each other to solve problems, creating a collaborative network in which the intelligence of the whole exceeds the sum of the intelligences of the parts.  The beta version was launched in early 2019 and AI running on the network is now being used for research on Artificial General Intelligence as well as to address a host of different practical problems including humanoid robotics, precision medicine for COVID-19, and biomedical apps such as Rejuve, which Ben Goertzel, CEO of SingularityNET, will explain in his speech. data.name: Planetwide SOS Hackathon - Keynote Speech by Paul Brody
data.description: Paul Brody of Ernst and Young speaks on "Why Privacy Matters for Business Applications".    Description:Blockchains should have companies jumping for joy! They solve numerous business problems without the risk of having a centralized intermediary become a threat in the future.  Unfortunately, few companies are making use of blockchain technology. This is  because most solutions that do offer businesses privacy just substitute one kind of intermediary (a web marketplace) for another (a private blockchain network operator).  For blockchains to be successful with companies, they need to be both properly public and decentralized, like the public Ethereum network, and offer those users privacy for their sensitive business transactions.  That's now possible but it isn't as simple as developing without privacy.In this speech. Paul Brody, Principal & Global Blockchain Leader, discusses what businesses can get out of blockchain technology, how developers should think about implementing privacy and why it matters.  Live streamed to the Conference Center's Meeting Center Stage at https://play.decentraland.org/?position=18,111&realm=artemis-blue

data.name: Stani Kulechov - Building the Future of Finance
data.description: Money markets have evolved into a primary use-case in decentralized finance. DeFi pioneer Stani Kulechov will introduce Aave Protocol, the open-source protocol for the creation of money markets on Ethereum. Stani will dive into how money markets can help users achieve financial freedom, and give some inspiration for hackers to build an open, transparent, and equitable future for finance.   ------- Stani Kulechov is the Founder and CEO of Aave, an open source and non-custodial money market protocol to earn interest on deposits and borrow assets. Stani was studying law at the University of Helsinki when he first got into Ethereum and he started exploring how it could impact the traditional financial system. In 2017, Stani released ETHLend, one of the first DeFi DApps ever. Since then, he has made it his mission to create tools for an open, transparent, and equitable financial ecosystem through Aave Protocol.  ---- Live streamed to the Conference Center's Meeting Center Stage at https://play.decentraland.org/?position=18,111&realm=artemis-blue

data.name: Jont live at London Underground
data.description:
"Jont's songs are the medicine the world needs right now.   Rooted in the experience of love and the healing of trauma, they are deeply personal and yet genuinely universal.”

JONT. A natural born poet with a guitar, Jont has spent his life connecting with the hearts of those around him through his songs and the vulnerable troubadourism that has always been his sonic signature. Along with releasing 11 albums, he has travelled the globe co-creating vibrant and soulful gatherings of intentional music as UNLIT and Gentle Warrior Song Ceremonies. 

His newest album, Thank You For The Medicine, is a collaboration with friends from around the world, mixing electronic beats with choir and string arrangements. 

Jont calls this new sound Medicine Pop. "It is the sound of freedom from shame," he says. "The sound of pure exhilaration. The sound of joy." He is currently offering the album and the gorgeous cover art by Vanni Mangoni as a free digital gift-download through his website 

https://jontnet.com.

data.name: Valentina Ferrandes Presents Sun Ra - Space is the Place (1974)
data.description:
Space is the Place 1974  directed by John Coney


After traveling through space in a ship propelled by music, Sun Ra discovers a planet he believes could be a new home for the
black race. 

Returning to earth, he lands in Oakland, California circa 1972. There, he has to fight “The Overseer,” played by Ray Johnson, a super-villain who pimps out the black race. 


Before the subsequent destruction of Earth, Sun Ra offers those who would follow him an “alter-destiny.” 

However the Overseer, the FBI, and NASA are all after Sun Ra’s Black Space Program; ultimately forcing him to return to space. Sun Ra, wrapped in the mythology of ancient Egypt and glittering with the sheen of space-age technology, seems too far out.

 He claims to come from Saturn, and he is at least three planets distant from Earth: as an African American
(Mars), a jazz musician (Jupiter) and an avant-gardist (there’s Saturn). Sun Ra felt the future for black Americans could be truly intergalactic.

“Space is the Place” is an Afrofuturist science fiction film made in 1972. A beacon of African American expression shining of hypnotic avant-jazz scores and lavish cosmic imagery.

data.name: Abner Harris Art Exhibition - G.C.A.W. 5/10
data.description:
Check out the exceptional work of Abner Harris at Arena DC, the first art gallery to open in Vegas City.

An artist working with both paint and digital media, bent on creating imagery at once strange, clear and balanced. Paintings are turned into vectored images, sometimes these are printed and painted on again. 

At their core, the paintings are about relationships between shape, and tone. The subject mater is more often not of a crypto-zoological or dreamlike nature. Here there are allegories, some so vague as to be detectable by the artist alone, others with several possible interpretations. 
The ability to be several things at once.
http://abnerharris.com/

The exhibition will simultaneously occur in The Hintalo Club in Budapest, Hungary.

Live DJ set from DJ Boycey!
 
Abner's artwork has been made available as NFTs for the first time for this show.
